selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Meridian Energy Partners LLC
Effective: 2 February 2024
Term: 12 months, then month-to-month.
Meridian Energy Partners LLC may not assign this agreement to a competitor of the provider. Other assignments require prior written consent.

selection_rationale: Consent-vs-notice distinction for assignment must be read from MSA-MER-2024 assignment clauses.
known_missing_information: Whether notice-only requirements count as consent is a semantic judgment not spelled out in sources.
